Name: Mizu's Horse
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Hay! Isn't this just the standard horse? Oh well, it's definitely a horse of a different color! This mod is for you if you like all things about horses! It adds horses and ponies as a new [b]barn [/b]animal. It's configurable, you can have disable ponies if you prefer. 

[list]
[*]Horses and ponies give [b]Horse Milk[/b] every two days. This can be pressed into [b]Marechego[/b] cheese in the [b]Cheese Press[/b] and brewed into [b]Kumis[/b] in the [b]Keg.[/b][/*]
[*]Five cooking recipes to find from the [b]Bookseller.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you build a [b]Stable[/b].[/*]
[/list]This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 5 new recipes to find and cook up. These recipes use all vanilla items (+ horse meat) or, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] installed, some of them will change to use those items instead or become flexible if you have it turned on in Cornucopia.

This mod has optional effects with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] installed to change the text of the recipe book when learning. It's entirely aesthetic.

[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img][/b][/center]
By default the Ponies are enabled. By default the Bay, Black, White, and Palomino Horse and the Bay and Dappled Pony are enabled. You can toggle on more below.

[b]Enable Pony [/b](true by default): Enables the Pony content.
[b]Enable Chestnut Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Chestnut Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Dun Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Dun Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Grullo Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Grullo Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Silver Roan Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Silver Roan Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Strawberry Roan Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Strawberry Roan Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Paint Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Paint Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Piebald Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Piebald Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Appaloosa Horse [/b](false by default): Enables the Appaloosa Horse texture and adds it to the possible horse appearances.
[b]Enable Cream Pony [/b](false by default): Enables the Cream Pony texture and adds it to the possible pony appearances.
[b]Enable Smoky Pony [/b](false by default): Enables the Smoky Pony texture and adds it to the possible pony appearances.
[b]Enable Sorrel  Pony [/b](false by default): Enables the Sorrel Pony texture and adds it to the possible pony appearances.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300]Special Power Utilities[/url] for some bonus features
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
5. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!

[center][img]https://imgur.com/5exTlaQ.png[/img][/center]
